senses.definition: an inoffensive or indirect expression that is substituted for one that is considered offensive or too harsh
of or the nature of euphemism

examples: his violent death was euphemistically referred to as a passing away

senses.definition: a feeling of great (usually exaggerated) elation
exaggerated feeling of well-being or elation
